title: Can Large Multimodal Models Actively Recognize Faulty Inputs? A Systematic Evaluation Framework of Their Input Scrutiny Ability

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Modality Trust Preference Score (MTPS) by presenting Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with cross-modal inconsistencies (where image and text conflict) and categorizing their responses as image-preferring, text-preferring, or having no preference to quantify their reliance on a specific modality.
